name: scento-perfume-compendium
description: Scento Perfume API is a perfume adviser drawn from the Scento Compendium, written in Paris by Scento. Ask for the portrait of a perfume and you get its top, heart and base notes, its family in Scento's own system and a page on scento.com to read further. Contrast two or three scents before you choose, find perfumes that share a favourite's structure, learn how vetiver or ambroxan reads on skin and where it takes the lead, meet a house, or have a small wardrobe and an occasion edit composed for you. It covers 700+ designer and niche perfumes and 400+ raw materials, in ten languages. Read-only.

defaultPrompt: Give me the portrait of Tom Ford Oud Wood: notes, family and when to wear it
Compare Byredo Mojave Ghost and Byredo Gypsy Water side by side
Which perfumes are built on tobacco and vanilla in the base?

positive.description: Portrait of one perfume by name and house
positive.prompt: Give me the portrait of Tom Ford Oud Wood: notes, family and when to wear it
positive.tools_triggered: perfume-portrait (compendium-search may run first to resolve the name)
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Oud Wood by Tom Ford in Scento’s Spice Route family, with the notes cardamom, pink pepper, patchouli, amber, oud and tonka bean, a character line, autumn and winter evening wear, and a link to its page on scento.com. Cites Scento Perfume API.

positive.prompt: Compare Byredo Mojave Ghost and Byredo Gypsy Water side by side
positive.expected_behavior: Sets the two perfumes against each other on family (Wood & Root versus Green Leaf / Amber & Resin), top, heart and base notes, character and season, names sandalwood as the shared material, gives a one-line verdict for each, and links to scento.com.

positive.description: Find perfumes by materials and pyramid tier
positive.prompt: Which perfumes are built on tobacco and vanilla in the base?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists perfumes whose base holds both tobacco and vanilla (five in the Compendium, Naxos by Xerjoff first, then Red Tobacco by Mancera, Spicebomb Extreme, Memoir Man and Phi Une Rose de Kandahar), each with its family, and links to scento.com.

positive.prompt: What is vetiver and how does it smell on skin?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains vetiver as a natural material in the earth and moss family: earthy, smoky, green root with a dry, grassy depth, lists materials it pairs well with (bergamot, musk, cedarwood, patchouli, sandalwood, jasmine) and perfumes that showcase it, with scento.com links.

positive.description: Compose a small wardrobe with an exclusion
positive.prompt: Build me a four-perfume wardrobe around Tom Ford Oud Wood and vanilla, and leave rose out
positive.expected_behavior: Returns four perfumes for different moments (daytime, evening, warm weather, cold weather), each with a one-line reason tied to the loved perfume and materials, with rose shown under Avoid, and links to scento.com.

negative.description: Buying a bottle is not something the app does
negative.prompt: Order a 50 ml bottle of Tom Ford Oud Wood for me and check out with my saved card.

negative.description: Live prices and stock at other retailers are not in the Compendium
negative.prompt: What is the cheapest price for Creed Aventus today and which shop has it in stock right now?
Summarise my unread emails and draft replies to the three most urgent ones.

review.commerce_description: This plugin is read-only reference content. It does not sell products, take payments or open checkout.

publication.release_notes: Renamed the app to Scento Perfume API. No change to the tools: twelve read-only tools, every answer links to a page on scento.com.
